Interface SchemaDiscoveryProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
OracleDomainSchemaDiscoveryProvider, OracleDualityViewSchemaDiscoveryProvider
public interface SchemaDiscoveryProvider
SPI for retrieving JSON Schema documents from pluggable sources. Implementations are selected by stable provider id. Built-in providers are registered directly; custom providers are loaded through ServiceLoader.
Since:
2.0.0
